mentions.name: Visor
mentions.description: Visor is a new type of trading terminal centered on options and gamma exposure (GEX). Its main feature overlays the options payout graph directly on the live price chart, letting users watch all the Greeks play out in real time — described as like tastytrade rotated 90 degrees on a live barchart.
